rows.title: Framework for covert and secret key expansion over classical-quantum channels

criterion: A paper must derive or prove a square-root law for covert communication, showing that the number of covert bits or signal photons that can be sent without detection by a warden grows only as the square root of the number of channel uses, in a quantum optical channel with a photon-counting warden.
